_about: Single source of chart colours for TR Power Lab. Colours are assigned by meaning, in families: a market keeps one colour for its price and its volumes; balancing direction is warm (system short, up) versus cool (system long, down); a plan is the dashed version of its actual. Light and dark values are separate validated steps (dataviz validator: lightness band, chroma, colour-blind separation, contrast). Change a colour only by re-running the validator.

markets._about: One colour per market, used for its price and its volumes. Stack order for volume shares, bottom to top; adjacent pairs validated.

prices._about: Each price takes its market's colour: PTF = GÖP, SMF = DGP, AOF = GİP.

generation._order: Stack order, bottom to top. The order is part of the colour-blind safety check: adjacent pairs were validated. Keep it.
generation._detail: Detailed view splits coal and hydro into steps of the same hue, light to dark.

balancing._about: Diverging by system direction. Warm = system short: up-regulation (YAL), Enerji Açığı, negative imbalance, actual above plan. Cool = system long: down-regulation (YAT), Enerji Fazlası, positive imbalance, actual below plan. Steps by instruction code: code 0 darkest, then code 1, then code 2. Undelivered instructions: hatched. Neutral midpoint: grey.

single._about: Default for a chart with one series and no market or source meaning (counts, loss factor).

rules: Plan versus actual: same colour; the plan or forecast is a dashed line, the actual is solid (KGÜP vs real-time generation, load forecast plan vs consumption).
Forecast or plan error uses the balancing arms: actual above plan is warm, below is cool.
Imbalance prices: negative imbalance price uses the warm middle step, positive imbalance price the cool middle step, both dashed beside PTF and SMF.
A ninth generation source or a sixth market is never a new hue: fold into Other or split into small multiples.
notes: Orange, teal and yellow sit below 3:1 contrast on the light surface: those charts always carry a legend plus direct labels or a data table.
'Other' is neutral grey on purpose and is always labelled.
Unmetered solar uses the solar hue with a diagonal hatch, never a new hue.
Status colours (good, warning, critical) are not used for series.
